body:
## What it does

Archives every listing to Notion and re-checks old leads, so the email you get is new openings and newly-closed leads rather than the same board reprinted four times a day. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @techking_007 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
